page.overview:
Who is Minwu?

Minwu, known officially in Japan as Ming-Wu and Mindu in the Final Fantasy Origins version, is a temporary playable character from Final Fantasy II and the main protagonist of Soul of Rebirth. A white wizard from Mysidia, he works as Fynn's Royal Mage. After Fynn's takeover by the Palamecian Empire, he becomes Princess Hilda's right-hand man who will do anything to help the Wild Rose Rebellion.

Minwu wears a white turban with a white cloth covering his mouth and wears a white robe with a gold pieces of plate in them. His turban and cloak are adorned with red gems and he is shown carrying a red and blue spiked shield. He has short hair, perhaps brown as shown by the sprites, dark brown skin, and blue eyes.

As a white mage, Minwu is naturally a person who takes care of the wounded and is loyal to Hilda and acts like an adviser. He usually talks in a way that things "are by fate have to happen," so he may have an external locus of control. When he leaves for Mysidia, he acts like a person on a mission because "his fate" is to obtain the Ultima Tome.

Minwu has long served the Fynn royal family as their personal mage and healer. Fleeing Fynn with Princess Hilda and the King of Fynn during the Palamecian Empire's attack, he helps set up the rebel base in Altair. When Hilda finds Firion and his friends badly beaten in the woods near Fynn, Minwu heals their wounds, sensing "a strong life force" within Firion.
